_readme: Frozen adoption-debt baselines for scripts/check-adoption.mjs (Lift 2a of docs/UX-MATURITY-PLAN.md).
A count may HOLD or SHRINK; a rise fails CI. Re-freeze after a sweep with
`node scripts/check-adoption.mjs --update --reason "<which sweep retired them>"`, so this file reads
as the scoreboard of what the sweeps bought.
Each entry: key · description · patterns (ripgrep-class, JS RegExp source, matched with the `g` flag) ·
optional `absent` patterns that disqualify a file · include/exclude globs over the POSIX repo-relative
path · mode (`matches` counts occurrences, `files` counts qualifying files) · baseline · `frozen`.
PROVENANCE (`frozen` + `history`, added 2026-08-04). `baseline vs current` cannot tell you whether the
baseline itself was ever justified, and the first `--update` proved it: run blind at the END of the
wave, it wrote every measured number down — the sweeps' wins AND a 494 → 529 raise on raw-button-bg —
and every class then reported green. (The earlier note here claimed these numbers were seeded at the
START of the wave; they were not. Every class read exactly `held`, which only happens when the freeze
and the measurement are the same run.) So each baseline now says where it came from:
· frozen.at        — the date this number was frozen
· frozen.value     — must equal `baseline`; a hand edit without a reason now FAILS the gate
· frozen.from      — the number it replaced
· frozen.direction — seed | lowered (a sweep retired sites) | raised (debt grew, and the ratchet
stopped guarding it) | rebased (the measurement basis changed, so the old
number was answering a different question and no credit is owed)
· frozen.basis     — fingerprint of mode + patterns + absent + include + exclude. Change any of
them and the gate FAILS rather than compare across incomparable numbers.
· frozen.reason    — one sentence, printed on every run
`raised` and `rebased` are flagged ⚠️ on every run until a sweep brings the number back down.

entries.description: Literal rounded-* utilities instead of the role radii (rounded-card / rounded-control / rounded-pill)

frozen.reason: The components/** sweep finishing the four-territory pass: 3005 -> 2450. Value-identical conversions only -- rounded-2xl -> rounded-card is 1rem, rounded-lg -> rounded-control is 0.5rem at the baseline generation -- so this is a theming fix with no rendering delta on the default skin. Frozen once against a settled tree with tsc rc=0 and vitest 698/8797 green over the result.

history.reason: Sweep, same basis as the addendum audit. The step half of the census reproduces the audit exactly (rounded-(sm|md|lg|xl|2xl|3xl) = 4,474, unchanged); the entire −75 is rounded-full (1,069 → 994), retired by the ProgressTrack sweep and the card passes.

Kit primitives sweep: every components/ui/*.tsx className moved from literal rounded-* to the role tokens (rounded-card / rounded-control / rounded-pill). These are the primitives every other component composes, so the roles now propagate instead of stopping at the call site.

Radius adoption sweep: rounded-full -> rounded-pill site-wide (value-identical, --radius-pill is 9999px in all five scopes), plus rounded-xl -> rounded-card on lines that PROVE the element is a card (border/bg-surface/lift present, button/input absent). Kit primitives hand-mapped. literal-radius 5413 -> 3851.

The two loading spinners moved back from rounded-pill to rounded-full. --radius-pill is runtime-editable in Theme Studio (feel: 'length', so an operator can set it to 4px and it validates); --radius-full is a fixed literal, deliberately not var-bridged, precisely so a circle stays a circle. A spinner MUST stay circular, so rounded-full is correct there and the +2 is the price of that correctness.

The icon-tile pass: 10 decorative tiles off rounded-card onto rounded-control, plus 15 hand-rolled icon squares retired into the kit's new IconButton bordered variant. Takes literal-radius to 3841, below the 3851 it stood at before the two spinners raised it, so that raise is paid back.

Five more hand-rolled icon controls retired into the kit (page-editor desktop back/close, calendar month nav, practice overflow) and three more small icon tiles moved from the rounded-lg literal onto rounded-control.

Pass 2a retired the last text-xs/sm/base/lg/xl/2xl literals in app, components and lib: the template-literal classNames pass 1's attribute walker could not reach, the page-editor tree it held out, and text-lg once --text-body-lg existed to receive it. literal-type goes to 0 and the floor moves with it so the sweep cannot silently unwind.

Instrument correction, NOT a sweep: the corpus is now comment-blanked before matching (CORPUS_BASIS strip-comments@1), so prose ABOUT a token no longer counts as a USE of it. Found twice in one day - a comment containing shadow-lg raised shadow-literals, and one quoting text-6xl/7xl raised literal-display-type, both with zero markup involved. Comments are blanked rather than deleted so every offset and proximity-window distance survives, which is why this can only remove comment matches and never move a real one. No code changed for this delta.

Real sweep, -40. Retiring the pill-tab tracks and their rounded-lg/md markup across the feed sort row, the capture-box and composer mode rows and the activity chart, plus the streak strips and the Invite card moving from rounded-xl/2xl onto rounded-card, and the post media frame onto rounded-control. Every one is a literal step replaced by a role token, not a re-measure.

Side effect of the icon-button sweep and the dock geometry fix: literal radius steps moved onto role tokens while the surrounding markup was already being rewritten.

Instrument correction, NOT a sweep, and no code changed for this delta. The old pattern was <button followed by bg-primary anywhere within 500 characters of arbitrary JSX, so it read formatting as much as buttons - collapsing indentation alone moved it 529 -> 564 - and it could bind a button to a bg-primary sitting on a CHILD element several tags away. The new form is an OPENING-TAG form: it stops at the tag own closing angle bracket, with the => alternative there so an onClick arrow handler does not truncate the scan (the same idiom handrolled-icon-button already uses). It therefore counts opening tags carrying the fill, and nothing else. Validated against a brace- and quote-aware mini-parser run over the identical comment-blanked corpus: 530 sites, zero missed, zero extra. The new form needs NO proximity window at all, so the length-preserving comment blanking (CORPUS_BASIS strip-comments@1) is respected trivially - there is no window distance left to preserve. 521 -> 530 is the old instruments error being removed, not nine new buttons, and NO sweep is credited for it.

So 12 tap-target floors across 5 files were counted as debt, meaning a PR that ADDED a correct 44px target raised the class and failed CI: the ratchet pushing against accessibility. Anchored at a true token start instead. 139 -> 127, exactly the 12 allowlisted sites.

entries.description: Icon-only <button>s sized and rounded by hand instead of composing IconButton. The primitive owns the 32px density floor, the 44px coarse-pointer tap target, the focus ring and the press affordance — every hand-rolled one re-derives those four, and the ones that get it wrong are invisible until someone tries to tap them on a phone (components/events/rsvp-controls.tsx ships a 28px stepper). DELIBERATELY CONSERVATIVE: the shape is `<button …size…rounded…>` then ONE self-closing element then `</button>`, so it counts only unambiguous icon-only buttons and undercounts the `{cond ? <A/> : <B/>}` forms. A first attempt merely looked for an icon SOMEWHERE inside the button and matched text buttons and whole card buttons — a ratchet on a number that means the wrong thing is worse than no ratchet, so this trades recall for precision. `(?:[^>]|=>)` rather than `[^>]` because a JSX attribute list routinely contains `>` inside an arrow function.
